decisions.reason: The module's 40-pin count is already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Clarifying that the module has 40 actual pins does not change any confirmed GPIO assignment or assignment policy.
The module pin-count clarification does not change the panel-control connector inventory, signals, or button placement policy.
The ESP32-S3 module remains a DCDC1-powered load regardless of whether its actual package has 40 pins rather than 44.
The pin-count clarification does not alter the standalone USB supply, powered rail, source selection, or programming behavior.
The 5V boost remains controlled through GPIO5, and the source does not change its loads or enable behavior.
The physical module pin count does not change the confirmed I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, speed, or cable constraints.
The clarification concerns the ESP32 breakout and does not alter the sensor-board connector fanout or connector count.
The module remains covered by the AXP2101 system power path; its clarified pin count does not change power-path behavior.
The source does not change USB data routing, connector requirements, enumeration, or programming behavior.
The module pin-count clarification does not change the LED data GPIO, supply voltage, power control, or logic-level interface.
The ESP32 remains part of the monitored downstream load, and its physical pin count does not alter rail-monitoring coverage or configuration.
